interpretation.requestedResult: Determine the lens separation after interchanging the objective and eyepiece at the same angular magnification.
stated: The objective and eyepiece focal lengths are 0.4 m and 0.3 m, respectively. Their initial separation is 0.2 m.
derived: A relaxed microscope with a real intermediate image would require lens separation greater than 0.7 m.
assumptions: The reduced optical model treats the two elements as ideal thin lenses in unit-index air.
unknowns: Object distance. Eye offset and unaided comparison. Accommodation and the distances held fixed during the lens exchange.
